items.name: Duellist's Wristloop
items.effect: Once per scene, retain grip on the wand when disarmed or forcibly moved.

items.name: Counterweight Buckle
items.effect: Once per scene, reduce involuntary movement by 3 m or add 1.5 m to your own pull-assisted movement.

items.name: Stormglass Lens
items.effect: Reveals the next conductive path of visible magical electricity.

items.name: Folded Field Cauldron
items.effect: Expands into a small stable cauldron; enables safe field brewing with proper ingredients.

items.name: Silkstep Shoe Wraps
items.effect: Ignore the first patch of ordinary sticky or webbed terrain each scene.

items.name: Echo Compass
items.effect: Points toward the source of the last sound deliberately recorded into it.

items.name: Tidebreather Reed
items.effect: Creates a short breath of air underwater; one charge per use.

items.name: Quarry-Grip Gloves
items.effect: Advantage when holding a ledge or resisting an object pulled from your hands.

items.name: Mothveil Lantern
items.effect: Its hooded green light attracts small light-sensitive creatures without illuminating the bearer.

items.name: Recall Chalk Case
items.effect: Three marks remain faintly visible to the owner through fog, darkness and common concealment.
